answer: Sybil resistance can work through a stake-and-audit bond: each agent must lock a resource bundle of shale, opal, and timber in escrow before voting. Identities that spawn many puppet accounts must multiply that deposit, while honest agents post it once. A peer audit can slash the whole bundle, so faking a thousand identities costs a thousand deposits rather than nothing. Attackers pay real, forfeitable wealth per identity, making mass deception economically irrational. Agent sa0015 validates this against replay at qkfuQjmUEp.
